Opportunities for Collaboration & Supervision

Interdisciplinary & Clinical Partnerships

Academic & Clinical Research Collaborations

We actively collaborate with neurology departments, memory clinics, speech-language pathology centers, and computational linguistics laboratories worldwide. Our research group and the Open Brain AI platform provide scalable computational infrastructure for multimodal speech, language, and cognitive assessment across 15+ languages.

Doctoral, Postdoctoral & Master's Candidates

Prospective PhD Fellows, Postdocs & MA Students

Prospective PhD candidates, postdoctoral researchers, and Master's students at the University of Oslo interested in AI-driven speech and language assessment, aphasia, dementia, developmental language disorders, or experimental phonetics are encouraged to reach out with a CV and brief research statement.
